_about: SYNTHETIC evaluation set for SENTINEL AI. Place names (Northland, Southmark, Eastria, Westoria, Karim, Port Velen) are fictional so no line here describes a real event. Purpose: regression-test the deterministic pipeline (story grouping, verdict rule, contradiction detection) and measure the LLM judge against the keyword heuristic. Extend with real, dated cases as they are collected.
